answer: Yes, we buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live in a different one, but there are two things to sort out first. Expired registrations are normally fine, but North Carolina is the exception: the registration must be current on the day of the sale, so renew your Virginia registration before your appointment and bring the registration from Virginia. A car registered in another state also needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before we can buy it at a North Carolina store. Because your plates were issued by Virginia, remove them and keep them.
